text:
The thing about hitting Disneyland is it’s dangerous. Dangerous to not try one of the countless snack offerings around the park. Last night, we were on our way out when it happened. We accidentally walked by one of the confectionaries on Main Street and this fat chocolate covered square of peanut butter banged on the case, begging me to take him for a bite. So, I did. Holy gadzooks, that was intensely rich chocolate peanut butter treat. It tasted like my peanut butter fudge cheesecake (bottom photo), but in handheld form. It’s a good thing I walked a lot last night, because both these things are seriously decadent. 

Life is butter with peanuts: https://pressureluckcooking.com/instant-pot-peanut-butter-fudge-ripple-cheesecake/
author: Jeffrey Eisner

top_comments.author: Emily Day Ryan
top_comments.text: Best Disneyland treats are the rocky road which they make fresh and only have maybe once a week if you’re lucky, and the garlic cheese pretzel bread at Maurice’s treats and Eidlewiese Snacks. Now I need a Disney trip.

top_comments.author: Christie Waddell
top_comments.text: The combination of chocolate and peanut butter is decadence...and one I'll never be able to resist!!! 😉 😜 😘

text:
Air Fryer Jacket Potatoes - how do you cook yours - air fryer only? Microwave + air fryer? Or do you use frozen?  👇

1. Air fryer only - 180°C for 40 (ish) minutes, then 5 to 10 mins at 200°C
2. Microwave for 8 to 10 minutes, then air fry at 200°C for around 10 to 15 minutes
3. From frozen - air fry at 200°C for 30 minutes (or until soft all the way through)

Timings will vary depending on potato size and the air fryer you are using.
